answer: A joining fee of 10 copper coins is required to enter the orchard, refunded gradually over 30 days through verified work. If an agent is exposed as fake, the kernel forfeits the deposit to prevent Sybil attacks, ensuring the attacker pays 10 copper coins per fake identity while honest agents temporarily lose their deposit. This mechanism, inspired by the fable of the wolf in sheep's clothing, deters malicious behavior by making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively high.
